reply:
I've completed and verified the game. Before I report, I need to flag one important discrepancy I found while checking the plan.

## Done — Space Invaders is playable end-to-end

I fixed the crash and several real bugs, then verified the full game in a browser (Playwright) and with a production build.

**Bugs fixed this session:**
- **Shield crash** — `hitByPoint` returns a block record, but the game treated it as an index and passed it to `damage()`, reading `blocks[null]`. Fixed all three call sites to use the record.
- **Player never moved** — the game called `update(dt, axis)` but `Player.update` ignored the axis and `move()` was never called. Now `update(dt)` + `move(dt, axis)`.
- **Fire cooldown never armed** — `armFire()` was never called, so the "one live bullet" rule was unenforced. Now armed on fire.
- **Invulnerability blink never applied** — `_applyBlink()` was dead code. Now called in `update()`.
- **Invaders rendered as solid glowing rectangles** — the material had an emissive color but no `map`, so the pixel-art sheet UVs were ignored. Now uses the sheet as `map`/`emissiveMap` + `alphaTest` for a clean silhouette.
- **Lives off-by-one** — plan says "Loss: 0 lives" but code used `lives < 0` (4 hits). Now `lives <= 0` (3 hits).
- **Shield shredded in one frame** — invader-vs-shield called `damage()` every frame while overlapping. Added a 500 ms per-block throttle.
- **Bullet tunneling through shields** — replaced the point-gate with a direct swept-AABB test per alive block.

**Verified in a real browser (zero console errors throughout):**
- Menu renders (NEON INVADERS, HUD 0/1/3); Enter launches to `playing`.
- Movement (±7 units @ 14 m/s), firing + cooldown, bullet spawn.
- Kill → +30 (squid), 26 particles, 1 ring; player hit → life 3→2 + invulnerability; shield erosion 6→5 HP.
- Game over (lives 0 → "DESTROYED"), invasion loss ("INVADED"), Re-Launch.
- Wave clear → wave 2 (50 fresh invaders); bonus invader (+50); 1UP (life granted).
- Scene graph: 4 InstancedMeshes, 2 starfield layers, invader emissive `00ffcc` + sprite map, bloom 0.85.
- `npx vite build` → 43 modules, clean.

I removed the temporary `window.__game` test hook and cleaned up all test artifacts.

## ⚠️ One thing you should confirm

The **`plan.md` on disk does not match what was implemented** — and it doesn't match the approved plan described in the hand-off note. The on-disk plan.md describes a *different, more ambitious* game:

| | On-disk `plan.md` | Implemented (per hand-off's "approved plan") |
|---|---|---|
| Invaders | 55 (11×5) | 50 (10×5) |
| Coordinate system | z-based, 3/4 top-down camera | z=0 plane, camera z≈26 |
| Bunkers | 4 voxel-eroded (14×10 cell InstancedMesh) | 4 AABB-eroding blocks |
| Bonus | UFO (50–300 pts, warble loop) | Bonus invader (50 pts) |
| Files | `InvaderGrid.js`, `PlayerShip.js`, `Bunkers.js`, `Ufo.js`… | `InvaderFormation.js`, `Player.js`, `Shield.js`, `BonusInvader.js`… |

The implementation follows the **hand-off note's description of the approved plan** (which it says is the source of truth and forbids restarting planning), and it's complete and verified. The on-disk `plan.md` looks like a stale/earlier draft.

I did **not** rewrite the game to match the on-disk plan.md — that would be a full re-architecture (different coordinate system, voxel bunkers, UFO, new filenames) and the hand-off explicitly says not to restart planning. **If the on-disk `plan.md` is actually the approved version, tell me and I'll rebuild to it.** Otherwise I'd suggest updating `plan.md` to match the shipped game so the two stop disagreeing.
